events.content:
Implemented the Reading Shelf app with a form to add books and notes, separate lists for books in progress and finished, and individual book pages with a copy-link button.

Books are saved to `data/books.json` on the local Node server. The file is created when you add the first book and is excluded from Git.

Run it with `npm run dev`. The production build passes with Next.js 16.4.3.

Key files: [shelf view](/workspace/app/shelf.js), [book detail page](</workspace/app/books/[id]/page.js>), [JSON storage](/workspace/lib/books.js), and [README](/workspace/README.md).

item.text:
Implemented the Reading Shelf app with a form to add books and notes, separate lists for books in progress and finished, and individual book pages with a copy-link button.

Books are saved to `data/books.json` on the local Node server. The file is created when you add the first book and is excluded from Git.

Run it with `npm run dev`. The production build passes with Next.js 16.4.3.

Key files: [shelf view](/workspace/app/shelf.js), [book detail page](</workspace/app/books/[id]/page.js>), [JSON storage](/workspace/lib/books.js), and [README](/workspace/README.md).
